admin.title: Admin console
admin.description: Platform view of workspaces, domains, members, and invitations.
admin.error: Could not load the console. Try again.
admin.membershipLifecycleDescription: Suspending a member immediately blocks access to this workspace and suspends their mailbox grants. Reactivating them does not restore those grants; they must be assigned again explicitly.
admin.suspendMemberDescription: Suspend {member} in {workspace}? Their requests will no longer access this workspace’s data, and their mailbox grants will be suspended.
admin.reactivateMemberDescription: Reactivate {member} in {workspace}? Their mailbox access will not be restored automatically; assign it again in the Mailbox access section.
admin.membershipSuspendedNotice: The member is suspended and their mailbox access has been disabled.
admin.membershipReactivatedNotice: The member is active again. Their mailbox access remains disabled until it is assigned again.
admin.membershipSaveError: The status change did not complete. Refresh the console and try again.
admin.mailboxAccessDescription: Control access to each mailbox for existing members. Their role permissions still apply. Invitations remain closed for now.
admin.mailboxAccessTruncated: This console shows at most 500 mailboxes, 500 active members, and 5,000 grants. Items beyond these limits cannot be managed here yet.
admin.noMailboxGrants: No members have access to this mailbox.
admin.noActiveMailboxes: No active mailboxes are available for access management.
admin.accessSaveError: The access change did not complete. Refresh the console and try again.
